package rulefixtures

import (
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

// scenario for logger_created_per_request: logger instances created inside handler functions
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: warning.

func scenario417Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	logger := log.New(os.Stderr, "[handler] ", log.LstdFlags|log.Lshortfile)
	logger.Printf("processing request from %s for %s", r.RemoteAddr, r.URL.Path)

	if r.Header.Get("X-Debug") != "" {
		logger.Printf("debug header present: %s", r.Header.Get("X-Debug"))
	}

	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	w.Write([]byte("ok"))
}

func backgroundWorker(task string) {
	logger := log.New(os.Stderr, "[worker] ", log.LstdFlags)
	logger.Printf("starting task: %s", task)
}
